edges.description: Reduced GARP/EARP assembly alters endosome-derived cargo sorting, including mannose-6-phosphate receptor distribution.

intermediate_mechanisms: impaired GARP-dependent maintenance of Golgi glycosylation enzymes
edges.target: Abnormal cellular and serum glycoprotein glycosylation

nodes.description: GARP dysfunction impairs retention and stability of Golgi glycosylation machinery, producing abnormal N-linked and O-linked glycoprotein processing in the VPS51 disease context.
nodes.id: Abnormal cellular and serum glycoprotein glycosylation

evidence.reference_title: The Golgi-associated retrograde protein (GARP) complex plays an essential role in the maintenance of the Golgi glycosylation machinery.
evidence.snippet: In summary, we have demonstrated that the GARP-KO human cells have defects in Golgi processing of N- and O-linked oligosaccharides.

nodes.description: Impaired VPS51-containing tethering disrupts recycling or sorting of endosome-derived cargo to the Golgi and lysosomal system, producing endolysosomal stress in patient cells.

evidence.reference_title: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by mutations in the VPS51 subunit of the GARP and EARP complexes.
evidence.snippet: Furthermore, a fraction of the patient's fibroblasts exhibits swelling of lysosomes.

evidence.reference_title: From Gene to Pathways: Understanding Novel Vps51 Variant and Its Cellular Consequences.
evidence.snippet: Proteomic profiling revealed 585 differentially expressed proteins, indicating disruptions in vesicular trafficking, lysosomal function, and mitochondrial metabolism.

nodes.description: Biallelic VPS51 variants reduce functional assembly of both GARP and EARP complexes. This impairs tethering/fusion of endosome-derived transport carriers at the trans-Golgi network and recycling endosomes.

evidence.reference_title: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by mutations in the VPS51 subunit of the GARP and EARP complexes.
evidence.snippet: Consequently, skin fibroblasts from the patient have reduced levels of fully assembled GARP and EARP complexes.

evidence.reference_title: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by mutations in the VPS51 subunit of the GARP and EARP complexes.
evidence.snippet: At these locations, GARP and EARP function to promote the fusion of endosome-derived transport carriers with their corresponding compartments.

evidence.reference_title: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by mutations in the VPS51 subunit of the GARP and EARP complexes.
evidence.snippet: The mutation in one allele causes a frameshift that produces a longer but highly unstable protein that is degraded by the proteasome.

evidence.reference_title: A neurodevelopmental disorder caused by mutations in the VPS51 subunit of the GARP and EARP complexes.
